Carrier Ethernet.meaning: Carrier Ethernet (Metro Ethernet) – a standardized, high-capacity Ethernet protocol and technology for telecommunications service providers used to connect customer networks across metropolitan or wide area networks.

MPLS-IP.meaning: MPLS-IP – Multi-Protocol Label Switching over IP; a protocol for efficiently routing data in telecommunications networks, often used by ISPs and telecom operators.

FTTH.meaning: FTTH – 'Fiber To The Home'; a method of providing high-speed fiber optic internet connections directly to customer premises.

ISP/Tránsito.meaning: ISP/Tránsito – Internet Service Provider and Internet Transit; in telecom, provisioning connectivity between networks (transit) and end-clients (ISP)

Configuración de red.meaning: Network configuration – process of setting, provisioning, and adjusting network devices (routers, switches, etc.) for telecom/ISP services.

Capacidad.meaning: Capacity – in networking, refers specifically to bandwidth or throughput provided by a service (how much data can be carried).

Puestas en servicio.meaning: Commissioning – the process of making technical network services operational (turn-up/activation) after provisioning and configuration, specific to telecommunications networks.

Documentación técnica.meaning: Technical documentation – creation and maintenance of documents (manuals, guides, configuration records) specific to telecom/network engineering.

Configuración.meaning: Configuration (networking) – setting properties or parameters of network devices (routers, switches, etc.), especially in telecom environments.

Direcionamiento.meaning: Addressing – assignment of network IP addresses within telecom network infrastructure.

Tránsito.meaning: Internet transit – the process of an ISP providing its customers with access to the global Internet; a term used in telecommunications for upstream connectivity.

Servicios.meaning: Telecommunications/network services (network connectivity, Internet access, etc.) provided to customers (business or residential) in a managed network context.

Offnet.meaning: Offnet – refers to telecommunications services/providers that are not part of the main service provider’s own network infrastructure (third-party or external carriers for last-mile access).
